name: Hastings Local Plan: The Hastings Planning Strategy 2011-2028

housing-numbers.notes: Housing target is 'at least 3,400 homes'. Committed housing includes completions 2011-2013 (373), commitments with permission (1,209), and small site commitments 2013-2016 (157). Windfall allowance is 35 dwellings per year for 12 years (2016-2028). Broad locations are 'other sites potentially developable - no planning status' from SHLAA.
